name: Darkspear Strand
summary: Darkspear Strand shelters the trolls who fled the Echo Isles. They came ashore on Durotar’s southern coast and built Sen'jin Village nearby under Vol'jin’s leadership.

sections.title: A Shore of Exile
sections.body: The Darkspear trolls came ashore here after losing the Echo Isles. Witch doctor Zalazane seized their home, so the survivors crossed the narrow waters and landed on this coast. They gathered just yards inland rather than scatter through Durotar’s hostile red wastes. There, they built Sen'jin Village. The strand looks across the surf toward the islands they still hope to reclaim.

aliases: why is it called darkspear strand
faq.answer: The Darkspear trolls landed on this coast after fleeing the Echo Isles. When Zalazane turned against his people, the survivors crossed the water and gathered nearby to establish Sen'jin Village.

faq.q: Why did the Darkspear leave the Echo Isles?
aliases: why did trolls leave echo isles
faq.answer: The Darkspear left the Echo Isles after witch doctor Zalazane betrayed his kin and enslaved his fellow tribesfolk’s minds with dark voodoo. Chief Vol'jin led the remaining uncorrupted trolls away to escape total subjugation, and they landed on this strand.

faq.q: What settlement is located next to Darkspear Strand?
faq.answer: Sen'jin Village sits just yards inland from the beach. Refugees founded it after landing, and it is the Darkspear’s main outpost and spiritual center in Durotar.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, this shore recalls Zalazane’s betrayal and your escape to found Sen'jin Village.
As a member of the Horde, this strand marks where the Darkspear made their place on Kalimdor’s southern coast beside their Orc allies after losing their island home.
